parameters.description: Path to the options page, which should be made accessible in the (legacy) Add-On Options menu.

functions.name: registerChromeUrl
functions.description: Register folders which should be available as chrome:// urls (as defined in the legacy chrome.manifest)

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Array of manifest url definitions (content, locale, resource)

parameters.name: windowId
parameters.description: Id of the window the dialog should be opened from.

functions.name: initLog
functions.description: Configure optional startup diagnostics independently of window listening. Call without arguments to disable tracing.

parameters.name: startupTrace
parameters.description: Optional startup tracing configuration. Tracing is disabled when omitted; the legacy boolean preference is checked for each trace.

preference.description: Full legacy boolean preference name controlling startup tracing. Missing preferences default to false.

logPrefix.description: Console log prefix. Defaults to WindowListener.

windowUrls.description: Trace only these exact window URLs. Omit to trace all windows.

parameters.name: windowHref
parameters.description: Url of the window, which should be listen for.

parameters.name: jsFile
parameters.description: Path to the JavaScript file, which should be loaded into the window.

parameters.name: aPath
parameters.description: Path to a JavaScript file, which should be executed on add-on startup. The script will be executed after the main application window has been sucessfully loaded.

parameters.name: aPath
parameters.description: Path to a JavaScript file, which should be executed on add-on shutdown.
